name: trustedDeviceTest()
description:
🤖: The user authenticates with the user name, password and OTP, trusts the device from the offer page. takes trustedDeviceToken from the device logs user re-logins
 ASSERT: actual and Expected trustedDeviceTokens is not null
 ASSERT: equals actual and Expected trustedDeviceTokens
 ASSERT: Home Page is exiting after re-login without otp(by trusted device)
